settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
1. Cleanse: Start with the Mangosteen Cleanser on clean, dry skin.
  2. Prep: Apply Restore Gel generously to treatment areas.
  3. Choose Application:
  • Use Applicator Probes for manual lifting with “glide” or “pinch and hold” technique.
  • Apply Eye, Lip, or Forehead Masks for focused, hands-free treatment.
  1. Treat: Turn on the MyoLift Mini and begin your session (15–30 min).
  2. Finish: Remove any excess gel and apply Anti-Aging, Revital C, and Eye Lift Serums for post-treatment nourishment.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: How do I turn on the Myolift Mini device?
settings.text1:
After charging the device, remove the charger from the unit. Press the circular
on/off button located on the top side of the device. The device will turn on and you will see
the display on the screen. Please note that the device has a safety mechanism built-in
and it will not turn on if the device is plugged into the charger.
settings.title2: Is the MyoLift Mini safe for all skin types?
settings.text2:
Yes, the MyoLift Mini is safe for all skin types, including sensitive skin.
Microcurrent technology is non-invasive, gentle, and works at a cellular level to improve skin
health without causing irritation or damage.
settings.title3: How often should I use the MyoLift Mini to see results?
settings.text3:
For optimal results, it is recommended to use the MyoLift Mini 2-3 times per week.
Many users start seeing noticeable improvements in skin tone and tightness after 4-6 weeks
of consistent use, with continued improvements over time.
settings.title4: How long does each MyoLift Mini treatment session take?
settings.text4:
A typical MyoLift Mini treatment session lasts about 15-30 minutes, depending on
the area of focus. You can customize your routine by targeting specific areas like the
forehead, cheeks, jawline, or entire face for a full treatment.
settings.title5: Do I need any special training to use the MyoLift Mini at home?
settings.text5:
Although no special training is required, there is a learning curve since the
Myolift Mini comes with two probes. However, our training videos will guide you through,
step by step, how to use the MyoLift Mini at home. The device is designed to be
user-friendly and comes with easy-to-follow instructions. There are also resources available
and free webinars to help you get the most out of your treatments.
